This '''Prowler 1000 seeker droid''' was deployed at a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Spaceport THX1138|transport terminal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to investigate the whereabouts of a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]]. The droid scanned the cabin of a [[StarSpeeder 1000]] through its viewport and identified one of the passengers as the spy, but the vessel took off, pushing the Prowler droid into deep space.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This droid only appears in one of the two randomly chosen opening scenes of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''.<ref name="ST2" />

The droid later appeared in a [[Hasbro]] ''[[Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|Star Tours]]'' action figure set where it was only identified as a "seeker droid." It was bundled with an [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial skytrooper]] and a [[signal droid]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Search for the Rebel Spy|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Disney_Parks_Star_Tours_Search_For_The_Rebel_Spy.asp}}</ref> It also appeared on a T-shirt saying "I am [[Unidentified Rebel spy|the Rebel spy]]."
